headline: I used it to replace Ctrl+F: ask any page in plain words → the exact sentence gets highlighted.

media.alt: Video from the post by Ammar Hussain

text:
Right now everyone's wiring @typesafeai's Jev into chatbots.

I used it to replace Ctrl+F: ask any page in plain words → the exact sentence gets highlighted. 107 passages, exactly 1 match, 1.5 seconds. Every answer quoted from the page.
